memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow‑up of coronary artery disease and newly detected vitamin B12 deficiency.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional exertional chest tightness relieved by rest, no recent angina at rest. He feels fatigued.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, pulse 78/min, regular. Weight 78 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 27.0 (obese). No peripheral edema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Stable CAD on current meds. Vitamin B12 low (to be checked). LDL elevated.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue aspirin 75 mg OD, atorvastatin 40 mg HS, metoprolol succinate 25 mg OD, isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD, GTN SOS. Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Order fasting lipid profile and serum B12, MCV, Hb. Advise low‑salt diet, 150 min brisk walk weekly. Return if chest pain at rest, breathlessness >20 min, fever >39°C, or black stools.

MCV: 92 fL (80‑100).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Electrocardiogram: Sinus rhythm, rate 72/min. No ST‑segment depression or elevation. No pathological Q waves. Normal sinus rhythm, no acute ischemic changes.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of lipid results and B12 replacement.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient says chest tightness on exertion has lessened; fatigue improved after starting B12.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/82 mmHg, pulse 76/min. Weight 77 kg, BMI 27.0 (obese). No JVP elevation, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: LDL still high despite atorvastatin 40 mg. B12 now low‑normal; continue supplement. Consider intensifying statin.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase atorvastatin to 80 mg HS. Keep other meds unchanged. Repeat lipid profile in 3 months. Advise continue diet and activity. Return if new chest pain at rest, palpitations, swelling feet, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: 6‑month review of CAD and lipid therapy.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient denies chest pain at rest, reports mild exertional discomfort only after climbing >2 flights stairs.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, pulse 74/min. Weight 76 kg, BMI 26.3 (overweight). No edema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: LDL improved on higher statin; still above target. Weight borderline; advise further lifestyle.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Add low‑dose aspirin 75 mg OD (already). Repeat lipid profile in 3 months. Encourage Mediterranean diet, 30 min walk 5 days/week. Return if chest pain at rest, dyspnea on minimal exertion, swelling ankles, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine follow‑up after lipid‑lowering intensification.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, no angina, occasional mild fatigue after long walks.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, pulse 72/min. Weight 75 kg, BMI 25.9 (overweight). No peripheral edema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: LDL at goal; B12 satisfactory. Weight still above ideal; reinforce diet and exercise.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue aspirin 75 mg OD, atorvastatin 80 mg HS, metoprolol succinate 25 mg OD, isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD, GTN SOS, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Order fasting lipid profile and B12 in 2 months. Advise maintain activity. Return if chest pain at rest, palpitations, sudden shortness of breath, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: annual review of coronary artery disease and vitamin B12 status.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports no chest pain, good exercise tolerance, walks 30 min daily without discomfort.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/76 mmHg, pulse 70/min. Weight 74 kg, BMI 25.6 (overweight). No JVP elevation, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: LDL well controlled on atorvastatin 80 mg. B12 normal. Stable CAD.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current medications. Repeat lipid profile and B12 in 12 months. Encourage maintain weight <70 kg (BMI <24) via diet and activity. Offer influenza vaccine (date to be arranged). Return if chest pain at rest, exertional dyspnea worsening, syncope, or fever >39°C.
